title: Wreaths for Rescues
location: Telluride Innovation Center, 300 S. Townsend, Telluride
description:
Celebrate your beloved pets, past & present, by making a festive pet-themed holiday wreath. Adela Floral will lead this hands-on wreath-making workshop to benefit Second Chance Humane Society. Bring mementos such as small pet photos to place in frames, a beloved small toy, collar, or keepsake that reminds you of your pet. You will leave this event with a beautiful, one-of-a-kind keepsake wreath.
Dirt Dawg will host a Stocking Stuffer Station where you can pick up fun gifts for your furry family members! Browse a selection of curated holiday favorites that you can purchase to spoil your pets. We will also have stockings for Second Chance shelter pets available for you to stuff with goodies or donations to make their holiday special.
Tickets are available  for $150 per person and include entry to the workshop, the wreath you make, a festive beverage, and light bites. Purchase tickets HERE.
